prompt: I just had Claude Code implement my Figma designs for the onboarding flow. Some things look off -- the spacing seems wrong and the colors don't match exactly. Can you do a visual review?

assertions.text: Checks for title case vs sentence case errors in AI-generated UI text
Verifies spacing against design tokens or Figma source values
Checks hardcoded color values against design tokens
Identifies creative interpretations that deviate from the original design
Produces a visual review report with specific files and lines to fix
